htn_kidney.title: Kidney transplantation in sub-Sahara African countries: challenges and lessons from the experience of Cameroon: a preliminary report of the first 17 pioneer cases.
htn_kidney.authors: Djientcheu VP, Ashuntantang G, Nono A
htn_kidney.zhSummary: 该文聚焦高血压肾病，属于临床研究。核心观点：本报告介绍了喀麦隆和中部非洲次区域首批 17 例肾移植 (KT) 病例的结果、挑战和经验教训。 临床提示：本研究包括在雅温得总医院 (YGH) 接受肾移植的所有患者。
htn_kidney.abstract: This report presents the outcomes, challenges, and lessons learned from the first 17 cases of kidney transplantation (KT) performed in Cameroon and the Central Africa sub-region. All patients who underwent kidney transplantation at the Yaoundé General Hospital (YGH) are included in this study. Seventeen kidney transplants were performed, nine females and eight males. All donors were family members. The underlying nephropathies were chronic glomerulonephritis (9 cases), hypertensive nephropathy (6 cases), and Unknown origin (4 cases). portal_hypertension.title: Association of Frailty With Waitlist and Post-Transplant Outcomes in Patients With Hepatopulmonary Syndrome and Portopulmonary Hypertension.
portal_hypertension.authors: Sharma A, Usman L, Lai JC
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究。核心观点：肝肺综合征 (HPS) 和门脉肺动脉高压 (PPHTN) 患者由于实验室 MELD 评分未捕获高死亡风险而获得 MELD 例外积分。 临床提示：我们的目的是确定卡诺夫斯基表现状态 (KPS) 是否可以预测 HPS/PPHTN 候选人的候补名单和移植后结果，并将结果与​​类似的低功能非例外候选人进行比较。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Patients with hepatopulmonary syndrome (HPS) and portopulmonary hypertension (PPHTN) receive MELD exception points due to high mortality risk not captured by laboratory MELD scores. These patients are often excluded from frailty studies, leaving the prognostic significance of functional status unclear. We aimed to determine whether Karnofsky Performance Status (KPS) predicts waitlist and post-transplant outcomes among HPS/PPHTN candidates and to compare outcomes with similarly low-functioning non-exception candidates. portal_hypertension.title: Vascular Ultrasonographic Findings in Canine and Feline Patients with Leishmaniosis.
portal_hypertension.authors: Martín NG, Verdejo JIC, Chacón RB
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究。核心观点：血管超声检查广泛用于评估人类血管炎，但与利什曼病相关的血管壁变化的兽医数据有限。 临床提示：利什曼病是一种原虫病，可能诱发狗和猫的系统性血管炎、门静脉高压和血栓栓塞并发症。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Leishmaniosis is a protozoal disease that may induce systemic vasculitis, portal hypertension and thromboembolic complications in dogs and cats. Vascular ultrasonography is widely used to assess vasculitis in people, but veterinary data on vascular wall changes associated with leishmaniosis are limited. This study aimed to establish reference values for abdominal vascular wall thickness in healthy dogs and cats and to characterise ultrasonographic vascular abnormalities in patients with leishmaniosis. portal_hypertension.title: Clinical spectrum, genetic variants, and outcomes of autosomal recessive polycystic kidney disease in Omani children: two-center experience.
portal_hypertension.authors: Al Riyami MS, Al Wahaibi K, Ahmed H
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究。核心观点：常染色体隐性多囊肾病 (ARPKD) 是一种罕见的遗传性疾病，其特征是肾脏和肝脏受累，通常在生命早期出现。 临床提示：来自阿拉伯人群的数据有限，特别是在阿曼，血缘关系很常见，可能会影响基因型与表型的相关性。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Autosomal recessive polycystic kidney disease (ARPKD) is a rare inherited disorder characterized by kidney and hepatic involvement, often presenting in early life. Data from Arab populations are limited, particularly in Oman, where consanguinity is common and may influence genotype-phenotype correlations. This retrospective study included Omani children (0-13 years) diagnosed with ARPKD between January 2011 and December 2024 at two national tertiary centers. Clinical features, genetic variants, kidney and hepatic outcomes, and mortality were analyzed. Kidney and hepatic severity were compared by genotype, and kidney and patient survival were assessed using Kaplan-Meier analysis. A total of 1...

portal_hypertension.title: Hospitalizations for schistosomiasis in Spain by sex: a population-based study using the national hospital discharge database (2016-2023).
portal_hypertension.authors: Ramos-Belinchon A, Otero-Rodriguez S, Belinchon-Romero I
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究。核心观点：血吸虫病是欧洲新出现的输入性寄生虫病，但有关非流行国家住院患者临床负担的信息仍然有限。 临床提示：使用全国出院数据描述西班牙血吸虫病住院患者的流行病学、临床特征、并发症和结果，重点关注性别相关差异
portal_hypertension.abstract: Schistosomiasis is an emerging imported parasitic disease in Europe, but information on its clinical burden among hospitalized patients in non-endemic countries remains limited. To describe the epidemiology, clinical characteristics, complications, and outcomes of patients hospitalized with schistosomiasis in Spain using nationwide hospital discharge data, with a focus on sex-related differences. We conducted a retrospective observational study using the Spanish National Hospital Discharge Database (SNHDD). All hospitalizations with schistosomiasis (ICD-10: B65) recorded between 2016 and 2023 were included. Demographic characteristics, country of birth, clinical conditions, complications, an...
